items.description: The aim of Food Care is to create a healthy service for clients interested to purchase web and mobile applications. The Food Care app offers resources from local dietitians targeted to a local community. The benefits of this app include connection to local restaurants, introduction to prepare healthy recipes, and personalization of a dietary plan.
Personalized healthy recipes in your inbox. Add items that you love to eat like Chinese, apples, or pancakes, and we'll email you a healthy recipe each day to make.
Provides tracking information of UPS packages, with visualized package locations on Google Maps.
A constantly growing mash website with different information from different websites in Singapore. The ideal mobile concierge for locals and tourists.
Facebook application for searching, rating, reviewing, and sharing summer camps. Put your favorite camps on the map and meet other friends who share the same experiences.
Breaking news as it happens via twitter.
This Service is a mashup service using twitter and google maps apis. It displays a users twitter status on the globe.
Services to help manage your deployments running on Amazon S3 and EC2 services: manage instances, backups, deployments, and monitoring.
An online flirtation site that lets you anonymously send pre-defined sms messages to people you know and check the read status.
Down or Not checks a website from 3 locations in the WatchMouse network and decides if a site is indeed down or not.
Easy-to-use web app that lets a user share and discuss highlighted passages from books they are reading on their Amazon Kindle or Kindle app utilizing the Goodreads and Twitter APIs.
New 7 Wonders of the world mapped on Google Maps along with YouTube video for each of the 7 wonder.
LastTube uses content from Last.fm and YouTube. You can watch Youtube content based on your Recently Listened Tracks scrobbled to Last.fm.
Indian entertainment site. Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu videos. TV shows, music, interviews and more. Categorized videos based on different tags.
A tool for reverse IP lookup. This site's language is Turkish.
A Bay Area apartment search mashed up with Google maps.
Website with YouTube videos.

Cardinal Maps is an online mapping company that focuses on creating maps for commercial distribution and marketing purposes. Some of the maps that Cardinal Maps create include tourism maps, events maps, bike maps, and business maps.
Wall Street Journal mashup uses Google styled maps to show what areas of New York City have the most Metro Card usage.

BanksNearMe is built with Google Maps API and the Google Places API and can be integrated with Bootstrap's mobile-first framework to help you find nearby banks and ATMs based on your current location, or by custom search. BanksNearMe is a free service.
Uses Google Maps and Twitter APIs to show where your Twitter followers are coming from and what they're interested in.
A map of crime in Richmond, Virginia's Church Hill Neighborhood going back to 2001.

BingAgain is a search engine developed with the aim of providing the BEST relevant results to users. What makes it unique? : You got to see ‘web’, ‘images’, ‘videos’, ‘news’, all results simultaneously in a single page. Not only this, but results (presently web only) are sorted out according to their popularity on “Facebook” which no doubt increases search result quality as well as their relevance.

LyricStatus allows you to share your favorite lyrics with your Facebook friends. Simply highlight your favorite lines from a song and post straight to Facebook as a status. You can post lyrics to your own wall, or you can utilize the Facebook Graph API to post to your friends' wall.
Local Daily Deals sourced by 8coupons.

Explore little doodles by zooming and panning with the Google Maps interface. These tiny drawings become an amazing landscape when you see them up so close - you can see the marks from each pen stroke and even see the fibers in the paper.
See the path for the 2008 Beijing Olympics torch.
Interesting combination of Google Maps with elevation data to show the impact of rising sea levels. Try it for your own town.

Yaptap enables communities to communicate however they wish: by text, email, phone, or social media. Group leaders can use either a web or mobile (iPad) application to organize groups, events and communications while members use the tools they want (text or email).
View incoming flights into 7 major US cities. Altitude, speed, heading and flight path are all interactively displayed on the map. Be air traffic control.
Apartment finding service for Chicago, The Homestead Group. Uses the Peekacity API.
Share code with developers through Twitter. Provided as a plugin for Eclipse (initially), use it to select a file or snippet of text in an editor and share it on Twitter.
